results.title: QLD Health Nurse Wages & Pay Rates 2026
results.description:
# Queensland Nurse Pay & Conditions 2026 QLD Health rates In Queensland public health, a registered nurse earns from $1,682.49 per week ($87,790 a year) to $2,158.11 ($112,607) across the scale, before shift penalties, allowances and overtime. ## Registered nurse pay scale | Step | Weekly | Hourly | Annualised | |-|-|-|-| | Re-entry | $1,607.40 | $42.30 | $83,872 | | Pay point 1 | $1,682.49 | $44.28 | $87,790 | | Pay point 2 | $1,761.55 | $46.36 | $91,915 | | Pay point 3 | $1,840.85 | $48.44 | $96,053 | | Pay point 4 | $1,919.95 | $50.52 | $100,180 | | Pay point 5 | $1,999.25 | $52.61 | $104,318 | | Pay point 6 | $2,078.75 | $54.70 | $108,466 | | Pay point 7 | $2,158.11 | $56.79 | $112,607 | ## Penalty rates | Shift | Loading | |-|-| | Afternoon shift | +12.5% | | Night shift | +20% | | Saturday | 1.5× (time-and-a-half) | | Sunday | 2× (double time) | | Public holiday (worked)
1.5× on most public holidays. Labour Day, Easter Saturday, Easter Sunday and 25 December pay 2.5× (3× if 25 December falls on a Sunday). | 1.5× | ## Ways to maximise your income $2,235–$3,726/yr Permanent Grade 3+ on 16+ hrs/fortnight get $2,235–$3,726/yr cash on top of salary, paid each March and September. $11,140 at yr 2 Stay remote and the isolation bonus pays $3,714 at year 1, $11,140 at year 2, then $7,426 every year after. ## Progression beyond the base scale | Grade | Pay | What it takes | |-|-|-| | Enrolled Nurse (Nurse Grade 3) pay | $75,573-$80,204/yr (from 1 Apr 2026) | Enrolled Nurse registered with AHPRA. Engaged at paypoint 2 unless re-entry. | | Enrolled Nurse Advanced Skill (Nurse Grade 4) pay | $82,578-$87,626/yr (from 1 Apr 2026) | Enrolled Nurse with advanced skills. | | Registered Nurse/Midwife (Nurse Grade 5) pay | $85,236-$109,330/yr (from 1 Apr 2025) | Registered Nurse/Midwife registered with AHPRA. Progress by annual increment (12 months/paypoint). | | New Nurse Grade 5 paypoint 8 | $122,873/yr (from 1 Dec 2027) | Nurse Grade 5 RNs; from 1 December 2027 onward. | | Clinical Nurse (Nurse Grade 6 Band 1) pay | $111,198-$119,072/yr (from 1 Apr 2025) | Registered Nurse promoted to Clinical Nurse (Grade 6 Band 1), by promotion only. | | Associate CNC / Associate NUM / Associate Educator (Nurse Grade 6 Band 2) pay | $124,991-$127,616/yr (from 1 Apr 2025) | Promotion to a Grade 6 Band 2 associate-leadership role. | | Clinical Nurse Consultant / Nurse Unit Manager / Nurse Educator (Nurse Grade 7) pay | $136,538-$148,242/yr (from 1 Apr 2025) | Promotion to a Grade 7 senior clinical/management role. | | Nurse Practitioner (Nurse Grade 8) pay | $153,736-$160,507/yr (from 1 Apr 2025) | Endorsed Nurse Practitioner / RN in a Grade 8 position. | | Director-level roles (Nurse Grades 9-13) pay | $157,018-$257,345/yr (from 1 Apr 2025) | Promotion to nursing/midwifery director and executive roles. | ## Allowances you can claim & rural/remote The fortnightly rates are $70.00 (Level 1), $100.00 (Level 2) and $150.00 (Level 3). ▸X-ray and radium allowance$28.02/fortnight (from 1 April 2025; rising to $28.72, $29.44, $30.32) An employee who wears a required lead apron, or uses/assists in using X-ray apparatus or radium, gets $28.02 per fortnight for each fortnight such duties are performed.
